model: OmniASR-7B champion (base + Kurdish LoRA), warm WSL server
provenance: scripts/scorecard_7b.py over per-dialect manifests from scripts/build_cordi_manifest.py (CORDI CC BY-SA 4.0, sha256 ff0ea0cb..., 305 synched films, 60 clips/dialect sampled seed=42 from 140,655 usable utterances). 2000-resample utterance bootstrap, same basis as the 7.03% FLEURS headline.
note: DOMAIN DIFFERS from the 7.03% FLEURS figure: CORDI is spontaneous dialectal speech from films and TV with music and overlap, FLEURS is read speech. The absolute CERs are therefore not comparable to 7.03%; the DISPARITY BETWEEN DIALECTS is what this scorecard measures. text == text_original for all 12,683 utterances checked, so the references are the dialectal transcriptions and the gap is not a standardisation artifact.
